channel.title: The Butler Collegian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Butler Collegian (thebutlercollegian.com)

item.title: OT: Sports and stardom collide
item.description: "Snoop Dogg’s presence as an Olympic host is not just a gimmick; it is a clear signal of where sports media is headed, as the worlds of pop culture and sports are continuously becoming more and more blended."

item.title: OT: Dan Dakich aims at Butler basketball
item.description: “In his attempt to garner views and followers to his ever-controversial X account, Dakich insulted two core pillars of Butler University – Hinkle Fieldhouse and Butler Blue.”

item.title: What you need to know: Men’s basketball faces No. 6 UConn
item.description: “It will take a herculean effort from Butler’s top offensive threats to keep the Dawgs competitive in this one.”

item.title: Winter Games: Bulldog Edition
item.description: “With the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics in full swing, winter sports have taken the international spotlight. While many fans watch from afar, Butler’s campus has its own group of students bringing these sports to life on campus. From skating, curling, hockey, skiing and snowboarding, these students share their passions for these winter sports.”

item.title: 170 years and counting
item.description: Founder's Week was celebrated from Feb. 2-6. Eliza West gives a recap of the events.

item.title: Blue IV steps away from public appearances, search beginning for replacement
item.description: “Blue IV has served as the mascot since January of 2020, making appearances in and around the Butler community, as well as amassing 121,000 Instagram followers.”

item.title: Beyond the box score: Men’s basketball battles hard, falls to No. 6 UConn
item.description: ‘“ I can’t let our guys say, ‘This is who we are,’ I can’t allow us to be who we are in February. We’ve got to keep growing. We’ve got to keep finding ways to get guys better.’”
